meta.captured_ideal: Struct files define the possibility space boundaries this repository's content may exist within.
meta.struct_description: This document defines the structure for all '*_struct.json' files within the repository. By outlining standards, rules, and prompts each '*.struct.json' is intended to accurately capture the platonic ideal for a specific file category (e.g., AUDITORS, DRAFTERS, TOOLBOXES, TEMPLATES, STRUCTS). This struct file (struct.json) attempts to outline the platonic ideal that is 'struct' files within the context of this particular repository.
meta.category_description: Struct files attempt to capture the platonic ideal of one of this repository's file types via rules, prompts, and descriptions.

base_audit.file_format: Struct files must be a parsable .json file.
base_audit.json_keys: Struct files must contain a .json structure that at a minimum of two levels deep has the exact dictionary keys as this file.
base_audit.json_keys_values: Struct files must contain a .json structure that at a minimum of two key levels deep has the exact value types as this file.
base_audit.file_category_value: Struct files [meta][file_category] value must be the name of the file type it captures.
base_audit.rule_type: Struct files must define each rule inside [audit_rules][base_audit] and [audit_rules][context_audit] as string type key value pairs.
base_audit.prompt_type: Struct files must define each prompt inside [prompts][audit_prompts] and [prompts][draft_prompts] as string type key value pairs.
base_audit.prompt_keys: Struct files must define each prompt inside [prompts][audit_prompts] and [prompts][draft_prompts] as string type key value pairs.
base_audit.prompt_content: For each prompt defined in [prompts][*_prompts] the key must be the file name of the file that contains the prompt content.
base_audit.prompt_location: For each prompt defined in [prompts][*_prompts] the file that the key is named after must be placed inside STRUCTS/prompts/*_struct.json/ folder.
base_audit.prompt_context_files: For each prompt defined in [prompts][*_prompts][prompt_file_name] there must be a [context_files] list which contains file paths of the files that the prompt will use.
base_audit.prompt_file_type: Each prompt file in the STRUCTS/prompts/*_struct.json/ folder must be a .md file.

context_audit.captured_ideal_value: Struct files [meta][captured_ideal] value must have a single sentence describing the platonic ideal that struct file attempts to capture within its rules, prompts, and descriptions.
context_audit.struct_description_value: Struct files [meta][description] value must be a detailed description of the file type it defines and the platonic ideal it is attempting to capture.
context_audit.category_description_value: Struct files [meta][category_description] value must be a brief description of what the category of file is and what it is used for.
context_audit.rule_keys: Struct files must name their audit rule keys as human readable words in a snake case format.
context_audit.rule_value: Struct files must have each audit rule value as a clear human readable sentence.
context_audit.rule_granularity: Each rule in a struct file must address only a single requirement for that file type.
